test_name: No accidental is drawn: plain, cautionary or forced (session 20)
description: cnb/layout.ly blanks the stencils of Accidental, AccidentalCautionary and AccidentalSuggestion. LilyPond draws a cautionary accidental (d?) with AccidentalCautionary, so before session 20, when only Accidental was blanked, it printed as a parenthesised traditional glyph. Measure 1 has a plain cis, a cautionary d? and a forced es!: none of them may be drawn. Measure 2's fis re-enables its Accidental stencil with \once as the control, so exactly one accidental is drawn, which proves the harvester would see the others.

assertions._comment: === SECTION 1: THE CONTROL IS DRAWN, AND NOTHING ELSE ===

assertions.description: Control: the fis with its Accidental stencil re-enabled is drawn, and it is the only accidental

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: PLAIN, CAUTIONARY AND FORCED ACCIDENTALS ARE NOT DRAWN ===

assertions.description: Plain sharp on cis (Accidental) is not drawn
Cautionary natural on d? (AccidentalCautionary) is not drawn
Forced flat on es! (Accidental) is not drawn
All eight noteheads render, the cautionary d among them
